My verdict

Cheapest useful clean: Life Happens Auto Detailing  — $100 for a small or midsize vehicle, with tax included.

Best affordable routine maintenance: Russell’s Car Care  — $109 before tax for a maintenance clean.

Best full-detail value to investigate first: PrimeTouch  — compare its advertised $199 special with its standard $239.99 full-detail package.

Best premium shortlist: The Detail Buff  or Alpine Auto Detail .

One important distinction: the $100–$150 packages are not necessarily equivalent to a deep interior-and-exterior detail. If you have embedded stains, pet hair, or neglected upholstery, compare the full-service packages instead.
